arguments.query: SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.amount_cents, b.request_id, c.charge_id, c.state as charge_state FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT h.hold_id, h.booking_id, h.flight_id, h.passenger_id, h.status FROM holds h ORDER BY h.booking_id
SELECT o.event_id, o.booking_id, o.event_type, o.status, o.attempts FROM outbox o ORDER BY o.event_id

SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, c.charge_id, c.state as charge_state, ce.idempotency_key FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events ce ON b.request_id = ce.request_id WHERE b.status = "pending" ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT c.charge_id, c.booking_id, c.state, c.amount_cents, c.idempotency_key FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id IN ("bkg_d6d457a1b9485a2e9fd994620f198df9", "bkg_2878e7020ef95030b475cce7df598e35")
SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, b.request_id, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.amount_cents FROM bookings b WHERE b.booking_id = "bkg_2878e7020ef95030b475cce7df598e35"
SELECT ce.event_id, ce.request_id, ce.kind, ce.step FROM customer_events ce WHERE ce.request_id = "req_772cc7e060fc560090e417608f16ea09"
SELECT b.booking_id, b.status, o.event_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN outbox o ON b.booking_id = o.booking_id WHERE b.status = "confirmed" AND o.event_id IS NULL
SELECT r.refund_id, r.booking_id, r.charge_id, r.amount_cents FROM refunds r
